brief: Today's news is dominated by natural disasters and geopolitical tensions, including a deadly earthquake in Indonesia, Russian strikes on Ukraine, and a looming hurricane in Hawaii. Meanwhile, AI research explores multi-agent systems and education technology, while academic papers delve into diverse topics from brain tumor segmentation to cotton fiber analysis.
news_summary: Major events include a magnitude 7.7 earthquake in Indonesia killing at least 51, Russian aerial attacks on Ukraine, and Hurricane Lala threatening Hawaii. Other notable stories cover economic concerns, AI in education, and social issues.
papers_summary: The papers highlight applications of AI in medical imaging, agricultural analysis, and construction error management, along with studies on genetics, psychology, and environmental monitoring.
